{{Quote|You have spent millennia on Tython with access to the galaxy within your grasp and have still not learned the ''truth''. At the bottom of the Chasm is a Kwa Infinity Gate -- the ''Prime'' Gate. It is a portal to all worlds and needs no other gate. It can take me anywhere in the galaxy.|Predor Skal'nas|<ref name="Force War 4">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 4]]</ref>}}
The '''Prime Gate''' was an [[Infinity Gate]] constructed by the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] [[Species/Legends|species]] located at the bottom of the [[Chasm]] canyon on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. This gate was the most powerful of Kwa Infinity Gates, as it did not require a corresponding access point on the other side. The Prime Gate could lead to anywhere in the galaxy of one's choosing.<ref name="Force War 4" />
